# ui::Surfaces

Header: `winui/ui/themes/Theme.hpp`.

The era-specific surface colors the built-in controls draw with: field borders, menus, tooltips, link states, separators and scroll bars. A custom control reads the role colors in [`Theme::colors()`](theme.md#colors) first and uses these only to match a built-in control's exact look.

Example: 
```cpp
// A custom menu row drawn the way the theme's own menus draw theirs:
class MenuRowControl : public ui::Element
{
protected:
    void render_override(ui::Renderer& r, const ui::RenderContext& context) const override
    {
        const ui::Surfaces& s = context.theme.surfaces;
        r.fill_rounded_rect(bounds(), 0.0f, hot_ ? s.menu_highlight : s.menu);
        r.draw_text(label_, bounds(), hot_ ? s.menu_highlight_text : s.menu_text, context.theme.text_style);
    }

private:
    std::string label_;
    bool        hot_ = false;
};
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field_border` | `Color` |  | A text field's border or bevel color, a sunken well or a 1px stroke. |
| `menu` | `Color` |  | The menu, menu bar, toolbar and tab strip background. |
| `menu_text` | `Color` |  | Menu item text. |
| `menu_highlight` | `Color` |  | The fill of a menu item under the pointer or selected. |
| `menu_highlight_text` | `Color` |  | The text of a menu item under the pointer or selected. |
| `menu_border` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | The popup's own border, when it differs from the field border. `nullopt` uses `field_border`. Metro needs it: its popup border is black while its text field border is white, and the field border would draw a white popup with a white frame. |
| `menu_pressed` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | A menu item's fill while pressed, and its secondary text: the shortcut, the submenu chevron and the check mark at rest. `nullopt` uses `menu_highlight` and `menu_text`, for an era whose menus have no separate pressed look and draw shortcuts in the item's color. |
| `menu_secondary_text` | `std::optional<Color>` |  |  |
| `tooltip` | `Color` |  | The tooltip background. |
| `tooltip_text` | `Color` |  | Tooltip text. |
| `tooltip_border` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | The tooltip's own 1 px frame, when it differs from the field border. `nullopt` uses `field_border`, as `menu_border` does. Luna needs it: its tooltip keeps the classic look, so the frame is black instead of the text field's `#7F9DB9`. |
| `teaching_tip` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | [TeachingTip](../controls/teaching-tip.md#uiteachingtip)'s body and tail while it does not close on an outside click. A tip that does fills with `menu`, the same in-app acrylic a [Flyout](../controls/flyout.md#uiflyout) uses. `nullopt` is `menu`, for eras that predate the control. |
| `surface_stroke` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | The 1px frame of the two surfaces that float over the page without being a popup list: [Dialog](../controls/dialog.md#uidialog) and [TeachingTip](../controls/teaching-tip.md#uiteachingtip). `nullopt` keeps each one's era frame, the field border for a dialog and the popup border for a tip. |
| `dialog_top_overlay` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | [DialogControl](../controls/dialog.md#uidialogcontrol)'s title-and-content area, laid over the dialog's own background, and the rule under it that sets the button area apart. `nullopt` draws neither, which gives the one flat face of every earlier era's dialog. |
| `dialog_separator` | `std::optional<Color>` |  |  |
| `split_view_pane` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | [SidePane](../layout/side-pane.md#uisidepane)'s default pane background: `#F2F2F2` in light, `#171717` in dark, and the window color in high contrast. `nullopt` is `menu`, the era's chrome face, for eras that predate the control. |
| `nav_content` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | [NavigationShell](../controls/navigation-shell.md#uinavigationshell)'s content area fill and the border around it. `nullopt` draws neither, and the page shows through, as in every earlier era. |
| `nav_content_stroke` | `std::optional<Color>` |  |  |
| `hyperlink_hover` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | A link's text under the pointer, pressed and disabled, where the era has its own. `nullopt` uses [`ThemeColors::link`](theme-colors.md) for hover and press and the subtle button's disabled text, the right look for every era without a hyperlink button of its own. |
| `hyperlink_pressed` | `std::optional<Color>` |  |  |
| `hyperlink_disabled` | `std::optional<Color>` |  |  |
| `separator_light` | `Color` |  | The etched groove's light line. |
| `separator_dark` | `Color` |  | The etched groove's dark line. |
| `scrollbar_track` | `Color` |  | The scroll bar's track. |
| `scrollbar_thumb` | `Color` |  | The scroll bar's thumb. |
| `scrollbar_arrow` | `Color` |  | The scroll bar's arrow glyphs. |
